selection_framework.room_temperature_strength: Useful for screening only; high-temperature capability cannot be inferred from room-temperature tensile strength.
selection_framework.yield_vs_rupture: For hot-section design, creep and rupture capability can be more limiting than yield strength.
selection_framework.modulus: Retain temperature dependence for thermal-mechanical FEA.
selection_framework.fatigue: Assess LCF/HCF, mean stress, dwell, oxidation, surface finish and notch effects as applicable.
selection_framework.fracture: Use toughness and crack-growth evidence matched to product form, microstructure and environment.
selection_framework.microstructure: Grain size, precipitate population, segregation and heat treatment can materially change performance.
selection_framework.anisotropy: Forging direction, grain structure and product form may produce directional behaviour.

material_selection_logic.need: high strength around intermediate elevated temperatures
